summary: T0-01 meets every acceptance criterion on evidence I saw. make setup, make check and make test all exit 0 (142 tests pass). The change touches only files in the story's list, plus the ml/pipeline pyproject files and package sources. I found no defects. The test-first criterion rests on git history, since I did not re-run the tests against a tree without schema.py.

findings.claim: SCHEMA_VERSION is a bare literal with no test tying it to the manifest example beyond a semver-format check.
findings.evidence: test_schema_version_is_semver only checks the format. This is optional to fix.

resolution.reason: Added test_schema_version_is_the_prd_example_version, which reads the PRD 8.4 manifest example and requires SCHEMA_VERSION to equal its schema_version (1.0.0). The models already implement exactly that example's fields (test_manifest_fields_are_exactly_the_prd_example_fields), so the version now follows the PRD too. A temporary SCHEMA_VERSION = "1.0.1" made the test fail; the real value passes. The SCHEMA_VERSION docstring now says a new version needs a PRD amendment.
